metaTitle: Rechargeable vs Battery vs Solar Lanterns
description: Compare rechargeable, battery-powered and solar camping lanterns on runtime, running cost, cold performance and reliability to choose the right one.
directAnswer: Rechargeable lanterns suit most campers: cheap to run, bright and often able to charge a phone. Choose replaceable batteries for emergency kits and cold trips, and treat solar lanterns as dim, weather-dependent backup lighting.
